search.query: | mstats avg("zfspool.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | 1=1 | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("zfspool.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*md_*degraded*","*md_*failed*","*md_*recovery_pct*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("zfspool.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*btrfs*uncorrectable*","*btrfs*corrupted*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("zfspool.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*reserved_pct*","*free_pct*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
